create_omat24_static_vasp_inputs: create VASP input files for an OMat24 PBE static calculation using OMat24StaticSet with a pymatgen Structure
create_omat24_relaxation_vasp_inputs: create VASP input files for an OMat24 PBE structure relaxation using OMat24RelaxSet with IBRION 2 and ISIF 3
create_omat24_aimd_vasp_inputs: create VASP input files for an OMat24 ab initio molecular dynamics run using OMat24AIMDSet with configurable thermostat and ensemble
review_omat24aimdset_incar_updates: review the OMat24AIMDSet incar_updates property to see INCAR parameters for temperature, steps, thermostat, and ensemble settings
review_omat24relaxset_incar_updates: review the OMat24RelaxSet incar_updates property to see INCAR parameters for ionic relaxation with conjugate gradient and cell relaxation
